title: Read
description: What the analyst (CHIRP) returns and the only thing the screen may draw. Every number and every line of copy on screen traces back to a field here. The screen never derives a new fact from these values; it only lays them out.

analysis_id.description: Opaque handle for this read. The pen hands it back to replay().

labels.description: One label per day, in the analyst's words (Mon, Tue ...). Length equals days. The screen does not compute weekdays.

calls.description: Skater ids, in the order the analyst wants them shown.

opp.description: Null when no opponent roster was given. The screen draws one bar and says so.

take.description: The one-line edge caption. Analyst's words.

verdicts.description: The line that drops at the end of a replay. replay(id) matches {ids:[id]}; split(a,b) matches {ids:[a,b]} as a set. If no verdict matches, the replay runs without a closing line.

take.description: One line of chirp for the panel.

data.description: What the numbers came from. CHIRP already reports this; the screen shows it in the panel footer.

id.description: Opaque. Live CHIRP uses the NHL player id; fixtures use slugs. The screen never parses it.

name.description: As it should read on the jersey.

club.description: NHL tricode; the screen maps it to a jersey colour token. Null draws the neutral jersey.

games.description: One bit per day of the window. Length equals window.days.

schedule_value.description: Drives ice quality under the skates. 100 is fresh ice.

reason.description: One line, the analyst's words. Shown in the panel row and as the default circle callout.

projected_pts.description: Analyst-computed. The screen fills a bar from it; it does not multiply ppg by games.

note.description: Injury or status note, if any.
